name: zclass_camera_set_horizon
description: zClass_Camera::gwCameraSetHorizon validates a camera node and stores the horizon node pointer.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44a910 validates null camera and null class-data error returns through zError::ReportOldNoOp, wrong-class return 3 with expected camera class type 1, storing horizonNode at camera data offset 0x08, and returning 0 on success.
The native camera smoke verifies the success store and null-camera error return.
